title:
Your company is an island.
BeZhas is the common port.
sub: Blockchain and AI infrastructure for B2B companies
say: Your company is an island. Suppliers, banks, customs and customers each work with their own systems, their own paperwork and their own timelines. BeZhas is the common port. I'm the head of marketing at BeZhas, and over the next few minutes I'll show you how the whole platform works: every app, every plan, and what each industry and each role in your company gets out of it.

say: BeZhas is built on four layers. At the bottom, the blockchain: BEZ-Coin, our ERC-20 token on Polygon, plus the contracts for payments, escrow, tokenization and governance. On top of that, artificial intelligence: OpenClaw coordinates multiple models, and an MCP connector lets your own AI work with BeZhas. Next come the SubApps, one for each business need. And at the top, OPERANT: AI agents that work department by department. All with one account and one invoice.

say: Getting started is simple. One: sign up your company and verify your identity. Two: choose a plan. Three: the Hub and the Wallet come with every subscription. Four: turn on only the SubApps you need. And five: connect BeZhas to your systems through the API or SDK, or straight to your AI assistant through the MCP connector.

title: A plan for every stage
foot: Prices excl. VAT · 20% off paying with BEZ-Coin · yearly: 2 months free
say: There are four plans. Starter is free: a fifteen-day trial, and after that you only pay for what you use. Creator Pro, ninety-nine euros a month, for SMEs and creators: real-time data and your first crypto transactions. Business, four hundred and ninety-nine euros: advanced reasoning, market history, a managed ERP and zero data retention. And Enterprise VIP, two thousand four hundred and ninety-nine euros, for holdings and institutions, with parallel agents, a dedicated node and euro-to-euro transfers. Pay with BEZ-Coin and you save twenty percent, and on a yearly plan you get two months free.

title: What really changes when you upgrade
say: And it's not just a usage counter. Each plan opens money rails with clear ceilings. Above a set amount, a person has to sign off, and above a higher one, two different people. So your team moves fast day to day, and management stays in control of the big transactions.

name: BeZhas-Hub
label: Social hub and marketplace
say: Let's start the tour of the SubApps. BeZhas-Hub is the front door: your company's verified profile, a B2B services marketplace and the ecosystem's community. Here you find partners who have already been verified, instead of starting from scratch with every new supplier.

name: BEZ Wallet
label: Non-custodial wallet
pts: Your keys stay yours, not ours
say: The BEZ Wallet is included too. It's a non-custodial wallet: the keys belong to your company, not to us. The company can sponsor gas so employees don't need crypto to operate, and if someone loses access, the guardians you appoint can restore it.

name: BeZhas Pay
label: Payments and checkout
pts: Card, SEPA and settlement in BEZ on Polygon
say: BeZhas Pay is your cash register. You create hosted payment pages, handle refunds and, if you sell online, connect it with a WordPress plugin. Your customer pays by card, by SEPA transfer or with BEZ-Coin, and settlement is recorded on Polygon.

name: BeZhas-DeFi
label: Web3 finance and treasury
pts: BEZ swaps via API, SDK and MCP
aside: Staking carries risk. BEZ-Coin is not an investment product.
say: BeZhas-DeFi is your company's Web3 treasury: BEZ staking and farming, a bridge between networks, liquidity, and the DAO, where companies vote on network upgrades. And from the API, the SDK or your AI you can swap BEZ without leaving your own systems. Infrastructure spend becomes an asset that takes part in the network.

name: BZ PureScan
label: AI, vision and traceability
say: BZ PureScan gives your supply chain eyes. Computer vision scans products and documents, the Food Oracle checks food quality, and every asset can have an immutable digital twin. When someone asks where a batch came from, the answer is already on-chain.

name: BEZ-Energy
label: Energy and green RWA
say: BEZ-Energy tokenizes energy. Energy-saving certificates, carbon credits and ESG data become verifiable assets, and companies can trade energy with each other on a peer-to-peer market.

name: BZ-CargoLink
label: Logistics and customs
pts: Cargo tracking with a shipment NFT
Escrow that releases payment on delivery
say: BZ-CargoLink brings logistics and customs on-chain. Every shipment has its own NFT with its full history, the payment sits in an escrow that releases only when delivery is confirmed, and customs clearance can be verified without chasing paperwork.

name: OPERANT
label: AI agents for each department
pts: Sales, Support, Finance, Legal, HR, Logistics…
Every action audited and anchored on-chain
say: And OPERANT, autonomous business management. These are AI agents that work by department: sales, support, finance, legal and more. On Starter they prepare drafts; on Creator Pro they assist you; on Business they work autonomously; and on Enterprise VIP their autonomy is governed by the DAO. Every action is audited and anchored on the blockchain.

title: Your AI already knows how to use BeZhas
msgs: How many shipments are held at customs, and how much money is in escrow?
You have 7 shipments at customs. Pending escrow is €41,200. Shall I prepare a summary for the operations team?
Yes, and prepare the payment for container CMAU-88.
Payment prepared. It needs your signature: I never sign or move funds on my own.
foot: Claude · ChatGPT · Cursor · your own agent  →  mcp.bezhas.com
say: All of this also works from your AI assistant. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or your own agent to the BeZhas MCP server and ask in plain language. It looks things up, summarizes and prepares transactions. But it never signs or moves funds on its own: a person always does that.

name: Logistics and customs
steps: The shipment leaves with its NFT and documents
PureScan verifies the cargo at origin
Customs checks the on-chain history
Delivery confirmed: escrow pays the carrier
say: Let's look at each industry. In logistics and customs, the shipment leaves with its NFT, PureScan verifies the cargo at origin, customs checks the history on-chain and, once delivery is confirmed, the escrow pays the carrier. No waiting for invoices or reconciliations. We recommend Business for the call volume and the crypto-to-euro rail.

name: Energy
steps: Meters record production
Saving certificates and carbon credits are issued
They're sold on the P2P market or retired
The ESG report comes out signed and verifiable
say: In energy, production is recorded, saving certificates and carbon credits are issued, they're sold on the P2P market or retired, and the ESG report comes out verifiable for the auditor.

name: Agrifood
steps: Every batch gets a digital twin
The Food Oracle checks quality
The distributor scans and sees the origin
Targeted recalls in minutes, not days
say: In agrifood, every batch has a digital twin and the Food Oracle checks its quality. The distributor scans it and sees the origin. And if there's a problem, only the affected batches are recalled. A cooperative can start on Creator Pro.

name: Real estate and real assets
steps: The asset is tokenized in the RWA Factory
A primary sale of fractions opens
Buyers sign from their own wallet
Governance and distributions stay on-chain
say: In real estate and real assets, the asset is tokenized in the RWA Factory, a primary sale of fractions opens, and buyers sign from their own wallet. For holdings and asset managers we recommend Enterprise VIP, with euro-to-euro transfers and dual approval.

name: Fintech and commerce
steps: Checkout by card, SEPA or BEZ
Real-time settlement on Polygon
Automatic refunds and reconciliation
Conversion to euros from Business
say: In fintech and commerce, checkout takes card, SEPA or BEZ, settlement is instant and refunds reconcile themselves. Start on Creator Pro and move to Business to convert to euros.

name: Manufacturing
steps: A digital twin for every machine and batch
Maintenance and purchasing by OPERANT agents
Tokenized machinery as collateral
Audit trail ready for customers and banks
say: And in manufacturing, every machine and every batch has a digital twin, OPERANT agents handle purchasing and maintenance, and tokenized machinery can serve as collateral with a bank.

name: CEO
pts: Immutable due diligence: mergers in days, not months
A vote in the DAO on the network's future
say: Now, by role. For the CEO, BeZhas brings a network of pre-verified partners, immutable due diligence that cuts mergers from months to days, and a vote in the DAO on the network's future.

name: CFO
q: Where is my money, and who moves it?
say: For the CFO, real-time settlement, ceilings and approvals by amount for every transaction, and twenty percent off the subscription when paying with BEZ-Coin.

name: COO
pts: Every shipment and batch traced on-chain
Escrow that pays only on delivery
say: For the COO, every shipment and every batch traced, payments that release themselves on delivery, and agents that take care of repetitive work.

name: CTO
pts: REST API, SDK and MCP connector
say: For the CTO, a documented API, SDK and MCP connector, up to twelve hundred calls per minute, a managed ERP and, on Enterprise, a dedicated node. No need to build their own blockchain.

name: Legal and Compliance
pts: Designed for MiCA, AEAT, SEPA and DAC8
Identity verification and limits without KYC
Zero-retention, and the AI never signs
say: And for legal and compliance, a platform designed with MiCA, the Spanish tax agency, SEPA and DAC8 in mind, with identity verification, zero data retention from Business up, and one rule that's not negotiable: the AI never signs.

title: BEZ-Coin: fuel, not speculation
pts: Staking and voting in the DAO
Buy by card or SEPA at pay.bezhas.com
aside: BEZ-Coin is not an investment product.
say: BEZ-Coin powers all of it. It's not speculation: it's the fuel that pays the gas for transactions, gives access to staking and voting in the DAO, and makes your subscription cheaper. You can buy it by card or SEPA transfer in BeZhas Pay. As we tell our clients: the token is the key to the club.

title: Start free today
sub: 15 days of Starter · then pay only for what you use
say: Your company doesn't have to stay an island. Start free today with Starter, connect your AI at mcp dot bezhas dot com and, as you grow, BeZhas grows with you. See you at bezhas dot com.
